prompt: Edit this painting by adding exactly two things and changing nothing else. Keep everything else identical: pose, arms away from the body, hat, face, robe, belt, leg wraps, sandals, line quality, flat ink-wash fill, plain empty aged-paper background, no shadow. One sword only.
